name: head-cave
description: A head-sized CAVE: three Planar Clarity Matrix G3 MX46X 46-inch LCD panels (1920 x 1080, 1.018 x 0.573 m active area, 1.7 mm tiled bezel) in landscape as front, left and right screens, bottom edges 40 in (1.016 m) off the floor, one computer with three displays: the front window takes the input, the left one is wired to the speakers. Viewer's head at the center of the box, floor at y = 0. Passive stereo: each panel interleaves the eyes by row, left eye on row 0; a panel that shows them swapped sets firstEye to right in its own screen entry, and a window that does not start on an even row sets phaseY to 1.
